title: Junior Technical Content Writer
company: Innova market insights India Private limited
description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION: Junior Technical Content Writer – Packaging**

**ABOUT US**

Innova Market Insights is a global knowledge provider for the food and beverage industry. We are at the cutting edge of technology in data and analytics for global as well as local category leaders. Our business intelligence guides the Top 500 FMCG companies to make winning, strategic, data\-driven decisions, both in product innovation and entering new markets.

**ABOUT THE ROLE**

We are looking for a specialist writer who can interpret the rapidly evolving landscape of food and beverage packaging. This role involves transforming technical data regarding material science, sustainability metrics, and global packaging regulations into clear, executive\-level narratives. It is ideal for someone with a background in Packaging Technology, Material Science, or Technical Journalism.

**YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Research and write technical content on packaging materials, formats, technologies, sustainability, and innovations.
* Translate complex technical information into clear, concise, and industry\-relevant content.
* Conduct literature, market, and industry research using reliable sources.
* Support development of reports, articles, packaging guides, trend content, and technical briefs.
* Analyze packaging innovations and communicate their material, functional, and sustainability implications.
* Work with subject\-matter experts and editorial teams to ensure technical accuracy and consistency.
* Review and edit content for clarity, accuracy, structure, and scientific credibility.

**YOUR QUALIFICATIONS AND SKILLS**

* Bachelor’s/Master’s degree in Packaging Technology, Food Technology, Polymer/Materials Science, Chemical Engineering, or a related field.
* Fresher who is interested in technical/scientific content writing, packaging, orrelated research.
* Good understanding of packaging materials, structures, applications, and sustainability.
* Strong research, analytical, writing, and proofreading skills.
* Ability to interpret technical papers, industry reports, and scientific data.
* Good command of written English and attention to detail.

**Benefits and perks**

The current requirement is for the Chennai location. Candidates from other cities will also be considered who are willing to relocate.

* Salary – As per industry standard
* Work Timing – 9\.30 am to 6\.30 pm.
* Working days – Monday to Friday
* Medical Insurance for yourself and your loved ones

**Interested candidates are requested to email their updated CV to**

**baliramgurunath.rathod@innovami.com to apply for this position and be considered for the opportunity.**

Visit our company website to know more about us:

**https://www.innovamarketinsights.com/**

Pay: From ₹300,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Leave encashment
* Paid sick time
* Provident Fund
* Work from home

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Chennai, Tamil Nadu

title: Youtube STEM Content Writer (Tamil)
description:
**Location** \- Zamin Pallavaram,Chennai (On\-site)

**Employment Type** \- Full\-time

**About the Role**

We are looking for a creative and research\-driven **YouTube Content Writer (STEM)** to join our content team. In this role, you will transform complex Science, Technology, Engineering, and Mathematics (STEM) concepts into engaging, easy\-to\-understand, and highly engaging YouTube content.

If you're passionate about storytelling, educational content, and making learning fun for millions of viewers, we'd love to hear from you.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Research trending and evergreen topics across Science, Technology, Engineering, and Mathematics (STEM).
* Write engaging, high\-retention YouTube scripts for long\-form videos.
* Develop scripts for YouTube Shorts, Reels, and other short\-form educational content.
* Simplify complex concepts into clear, relatable, and audience\-friendly language.
* Create compelling hooks, curiosity loops, storytelling angles, and engaging narratives to maximize audience retention.
* Research industry trends, competitors, and viral content formats to improve content performance.
* Collaborate with content creators, video editors, and the creative team to optimize script quality and viewer engagement.
* Ensure content is factually accurate, informative, and aligned with the channel's content strategy.
* Continuously explore innovative storytelling techniques to enhance watch time and audience engagement.

**Required Skills \& Qualifications**

* Excellent writing, editing, and storytelling skills.
* Strong research and analytical abilities.
* Ability to simplify technical and scientific concepts for a broad audience.
* Passion for STEM, innovation, science, and emerging technologies.
* Understanding of YouTube content strategy, audience retention, watch time, and storytelling techniques.
* Creative thinking with a curiosity\-driven mindset.
* Ability to meet deadlines and manage multiple projects effectively.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in YouTube scriptwriting, journalism, education, technical writing, or digital content creation.
* Experience writing educational or documentary\-style content.
* Familiarity with YouTube analytics and content optimization strategies is an added advantage.

**Why Join Us?**

* Opportunity to build impactful educational content that reaches a large audience.
* Work with a creative and innovative team focused on STEM education.
* Contribute to building a mass\-scale STEM media brand that inspires the next generation of innovators.
* Gain exposure to cutting\-edge educational content and digital storytelling.
* Opportunities for continuous learning, creativity, and career growth.

If you're passionate about creating engaging educational content and want to make STEM accessible and exciting for everyone, we'd love to hear from you!

Pay: ₹20,000\.00 \- ₹25,000\.00 per month

* Provident Fund

title: Food & Nutraceutical Content Writer – QC Specialist
description:
**Food \& Nutraceutical Content Writer – QC Specialist**

Location: IIT Madras, Chennai

Experience: 0–1 Year

Qualification: Bachelor’s / Master’s Degree

Salary: ₹15,000 – ₹25,000 per month

Industry: Food \& Nutraceuticals

**About the Role**

We are looking for a Food \& Nutraceutical Content Writer \& QC Specialist to join our team at IIT Madras.

The candidate will be responsible for creating, reviewing, and quality\-checking content across R\&D, software, and marketing functions. The ideal candidate should have a strong academic background in Food Science, Food Technology, Nutrition, Nutraceuticals, or a related field, along with strong writing and research skills.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop and edit scientific and technical content related to food and nutraceuticals.
* Prepare R\&D content, research summaries, technical documents, ingredient profiles, and product\-related content.
* Create content for software platforms and digital products in the food and nutraceutical domain.
* Develop **marketing content** for websites, blogs, product pages, brochures, presentations, and social media.
* Conduct research using scientific journals, databases, and reliable sources.
* Review content for scientific accuracy, clarity, grammar, spelling, and consistency.

**Perform detailed Quality Control (QC) of technical, R\&D, software, and marketing content.**

* Identify and correct factual errors, inconsistencies, and gaps in content.
* Review nutritional, functional, and health\-related claims for accuracy and appropriate supporting evidence.
* Convert complex scientific concepts into simple, clear, and engaging content.
* Work closely with R\&D, Product, Marketing, and Technology teams.
* Maintain QC checklists, documentation, and content review processes.
* Ensure all content is delivered accurately and within deadlines.

**Required Skills**

* Strong knowledge of Food Science / Food Technology / Nutrition / Nutraceuticals.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong scientific and technical writing ability.
* Good proofreading and editing skills.
* Strong research and analytical skills.
* Excellent attention to detail.
* Ability to understand and interpret scientific literature.
* Ability to simplify complex technical information.
* Good understanding of food ingredients, nutrition, functional foods, and nutraceuticals.
* Ability to work across R\&D, software, and marketing content.

**Educational Qualification**

* Candidates with a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in:
* Food Science
* Food Technology
* Nutrition / Nutrition \& Dietetics
* Nutraceuticals with relevant domain knowledge
* Freshers are welcome to apply.

**How to Apply**

Interested candidates can send their updated resume to: careers@beetloop.com or this Contact Number 87544 46692

The Indus Valley is India’s fastest\-growing D2C brand revolutionizing the cookware industry with sustainable and healthy products. Our mission is to transform everyday cooking with eco\-friendly, toxin\-free solutions that promote better living.
